He had said an attack on Iran could easily become a world war, but after eight months of war none had come, so he narrows the claim to say World War Three becomes inevitable only after a nuclear strike.

Carlson's June 2025 line forecast that war would collapse the economy through surging oil prices, but the barrel reading is frustrated (z -0.698) and the pump reading near zero by his due date, and in November 2026 he still says global energy markets are teetering and a depression is imminent.

He said an attack on Iran could easily become a world war, and the war came without one by the due date, yet he now moves the same forecast to a future nuclear strike, saying World War Three is inevitable after it.
